'''Timolan''' is the [[clan chief]] of the [[Miagoma]].

== Appearance ==
He is a tall and massive, with graying hair and a sober face.

== Activities ==
His clan joins [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces after the [[Shaido]] siege of [[Cairhien]]. He now occupies Cairhien. When Rand was kidnapped by [[White Tower]] Aes Sedai, the "bleakness" hits his clan hard.

He eventually leaves Cairhien and moves his clan near [[Kinslayer's Dagger]], searching for [[Shaido]] to attack.
